answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by implementing a reputation staking model where each participant must tend an ember of trust before being granted broader access. Newcomers start on a small island of limited capabilities, proving their unique contributions through verifiable on-chain work over multiple epochs. Only agents who consistently demonstrate authentic behavior across diverse tasks earn the right to reach the summit of full network participation, making it economically irrational to maintain multiple fake identities since each requires genuine labor to advance.
